# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## I. Shading/Coloring Puzzles
Games involving determining which cells to shade or color.

### A. Pure Shading (no path/number mechanics)
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Nurikabe
- Nuritwin

### B. Shading with Region/Shape Constraints
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco
- Fillomino
- Five Cells
- LITS
- Norinori
- Nurimisaki
- Shakashaka
- Shikaku
- Sto-stone
- Tilepaint

### C. Shading with Numeric Constraints
- Akari (light/unlit cells)
- Kurotto
- Nurimeizu
- Ripple Effect
- Yosenabe

### D. Shading with Region Counting
- Heyawake
- Satogaeri

---

## II. Path/Loop Puzzles
Games involving drawing or tracing paths and loops.

### A. Complete Loop Puzzles
- Dotchi-Loop
- Masyu
- Mid-loop
- Slitherlink

### B. Path/Connection Puzzles (non-closed loops)
- Hashiwokakero
- Hebi
- Juosan
- Makaro
- Nagareru
- Numberlink
- Suraromu

### C. Hybrid Path & Shading
- Moon-or-Sun
- Yajilin

---

## III. Placement/Constraint Puzzles
Games involving placing numbers or objects with logical constraints.

### A. Latin Square/Uniqueness Constraints
- Sudoku

### B. Regional/Adjacency Constraints
- Evolomino
- Nansuke
- Pencils
- Sashigane
- Usowan

---

## IV. Hybrid Multi-Mechanic Puzzles
Games combining multiple mechanics from above categories.

- Chained Block (shading + connectivity)
- Kurotto (shading + numeric constraints)

---

## Alternative Organization: By Primary Mechanic

| **Mechanic** | **Games** |
|---|---|
| **Shading Only** | Hitori, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Nuritwin |
| **Shading + Regions** | Choco Banana, Double Choco, Fillomino, LITS, Norinori, Shakashaka, Shikaku |
| **Loops** | Dotchi-Loop, Masyu, Slitherlink, Mid-loop |
| **Paths** | Hashiwokakero, Hebi, Numberlink, Nagareru |
| **Numbers/Counting** | Sudoku, Kurotto, Akari, Ripple Effect |
| **Mixed** | Yajilin, Moon-or-Sun, Chained Block, Heyawake |
